d: Bihar men setu-pul ka nam badalkar 'nitish brij' kie jane ko lekar rajnitik halchal tej ho gaee hai. is mudde par jahanabad ke rashtriy janta dal (RJD) vidhayak rahul kumar ne janta dal yunaited (JDU) aur bhartiy janta parti (BJP) par tikha hamla bola hai. midiya se batchit karte hue vidhayak rahul kumar ne pul ke namakran aur JDU neta shyam rajak ki bayanbaji ko lekar kaee ganbhir saval uthae hain.
